about.paragraph2: His training philosophy centers on holistic wellness—strengthening not just the body, but also building mental resilience and sustainable habits. Whether you're a beginner taking your first steps or an athlete pushing for peak performance, Elishay provides the expertise, motivation, and personalized attention needed to unlock your full potential.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.a1: Training frequency depends on your goals, experience level, and recovery capacity. Beginners typically benefit from 3-4 sessions per week, while advanced trainees may train 5-6 times weekly. We'll design a program that matches your schedule and maximizes results.
faq.a2: Beginners should focus on establishing consistent eating habits, balanced macronutrients, and adequate protein intake. We'll create a simple, sustainable meal plan that teaches fundamentals while supporting your training goals. No extreme diets—just smart, practical nutrition.
faq.q3: Can I achieve results with digital programs alone?
faq.a3: Absolutely! Our digital programs are comprehensive and include detailed instructions, progress tracking, and support. Many clients achieve excellent results remotely. However, combining digital programs with occasional personal training sessions can accelerate progress.
faq.q4: How long until I see results?
faq.a4: Results vary based on consistency, effort, and individual factors. Most clients notice improvements in energy and strength within 2-4 weeks. Visible body composition changes typically appear after 6-8 weeks of consistent training and proper nutrition. We'll track your progress and adjust as needed.
faq.a5: Yes! Nutrition consultations are available as part of our comprehensive service packages. We'll analyze your current eating habits, create personalized meal plans, and provide ongoing guidance to ensure your nutrition supports your fitness goals effectively.

tips.title: Pro Tips
tips.subtitle: Expert advice for your fitness journey
tips.tip1: Consistency beats intensity—regular, moderate training yields better long-term results than sporadic intense sessions.
tips.tip2: Prioritize recovery—adequate sleep and rest days are crucial for muscle growth and performance improvement.
tips.tip3: Track your progress—keeping a training and nutrition log helps identify what works and keeps you motivated.
tips.tip4: Stay hydrated—proper hydration supports performance, recovery, and overall health throughout your training.
